definitions.gloss: formal meeting for marriage, matchmaking, arranged introduction
definitions.explanation: A formal meeting arranged by a go-between or family members for the purpose of considering marriage. The prospective bride and groom meet, often with their families, to evaluate compatibility.

examples.japanese: {見合|みあ}いをすることになった。
examples.english: It was decided that I would have an arranged meeting.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}に{勧|すす}められて{見合|みあ}いの{相手|あいて}に{会|あ}った。
examples.english: At my mother's recommendation, I met with the person from the arranged introduction.

examples.japanese: {見合|みあ}い{結婚|けっこん}と{恋愛|れんあい}{結婚|けっこん}のどちらが{多|おお}いか、{時代|じだい}によって{変|か}わる。
examples.english: Whether arranged marriages or love marriages are more common changes with the times.

notes:
USAGE:
{見合|みあ}い traditionally involves a {仲人|なこうど} (go-between) who arranges the meeting and facilitates introductions. Modern {見合|みあ}い has evolved considerably and may be quite casual. The word contrasts with {恋愛|れんあい} (romantic love) — marriages are often classified as either {見合|みあ}い{結婚|けっこん} (arranged marriage) or {恋愛|れんあい}{結婚|けっこん} (love marriage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見合|みあ}い{結婚|けっこん}: arranged marriage
- {見合|みあ}い{相手|あいて}: matchmaking partner
- {見合|みあ}いをする: to have an arranged meeting
- {見合|みあ}い{写真|しゃしん}: photo used for matchmaking
